detail.longDescription: Just fixed a # Gentoo Xen issue (hypervisor) — https:// bugs.gentoo.org/967841 — then moved on to Xen 4.22.0, the current upstream release, and rebased a Gentoo ncurses/tinfo patch that had drifted against the newer Autoconf-generated configure script. Result: xen-tools-4.22.0 successfully compiled. A fitting labor of love for a Labor Day project. Could not have done it nearly as quickly without # ChatGPT helping isolate the failure and accelerate the patch work.
